title: Trump's NUCLEAR OPTION Could STOP Democrat Redistricting Scheme In Virginia
tags: the culture war with tim pool
description:
Trump signals he may deploy a political “nuclear option” to counter a Democrat-led redistricting push in Virginia that could flip up to four House seats. The controversial plan would redraw districts to heavily favor Democrats, potentially shifting the balance of power in Congress.
